name: Bun Graph DB OpenAPI Document Surface
description: Expose a stable OpenAPI 3.2 document for bun-graph-db REST and MCP protocol endpoints while keeping runtime table schemas available through dynamic projection exports.

userStories.title: Define full document scope
userStories.description: As an API maintainer, I want a clear full-document scope so that stable API surfaces are documented without freezing dynamic table schemas.
acceptanceCriteria: Document that full-api-document covers stable REST and MCP protocol endpoints only.
Document that runtime table schemas remain available through table projection endpoints.
Document that table projections must be referenced or linked, not eagerly inlined into the static full document.
Include versionHash and projection profile guidance for schema freshness.
Add non-goals for client/router generation over arbitrary runtime table shapes.
bun run typecheck passes.
bun run lint --max-diagnostics=20 passes.
Focused OpenAPI/MCP projection tests for changed behavior pass.
bun run build passes.
userStories.notes: This story sets boundaries before implementation so agents do not inline dynamic table schemas into a static document.

userStories.title: Add static OpenAPI document builder
userStories.description: As a client developer, I want bun-graph-db to build a stable OpenAPI 3.2 document so that I can inspect and generate clients for the stable API surface.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a pure builder for the static bun-graph-db OpenAPI 3.2 document.
Builder returns openapi: "3.2.0", info, paths, and reusable components.
Builder includes REST projection endpoint GET /api/tables/{tableId}/openapi-projection.
Builder includes MCP endpoints /mcp and /sub/{tableId}/mcp as JSON-RPC POST operations.
Builder includes reusable JSON-RPC request/response/error schemas.
Builder includes common query/path parameters such as tableId and projection profile.
Builder has unit tests for required paths, schemas, and parameters.
bun run typecheck passes.
bun run lint --max-diagnostics=20 passes.
Focused OpenAPI/MCP projection tests for changed behavior pass.
bun run build passes.
userStories.notes: Prefer a pure builder module before wiring HTTP routes.

userStories.title: Expose full document through REST
userStories.description: As an API consumer, I want to fetch the stable OpenAPI document over REST so that tooling can discover bun-graph-db without repository access.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a REST endpoint such as GET /api/openapi.
Endpoint returns the static OpenAPI 3.2 document.
Endpoint response uses application/json.
Endpoint does not require a table id.
Endpoint does not inline dynamic table-specific schemas.
Unit or integration test verifies status, content type, and document shape.
bun run typecheck passes.
bun run lint --max-diagnostics=20 passes.
Focused OpenAPI/MCP projection tests for changed behavior pass.
bun run build passes.
userStories.notes: Endpoint name can be finalized during implementation; keep route stable once introduced.

userStories.title: Represent MCP tool discovery in OpenAPI
userStories.description: As an MCP client developer, I want MCP protocol calls represented in OpenAPI so that the transport contract is inspectable through standard tooling.
acceptanceCriteria: OpenAPI components include schemas for initialize, tools/list, and tools/call JSON-RPC requests.
OpenAPI components include schemas for MCP content blocks and tool definitions.
/mcp POST request body accepts a JSON-RPC request union or documented generic envelope.
/sub/{tableId}/mcp POST request body accepts table-scoped JSON-RPC calls.
The document explains that tool-specific arguments schemas are discovered dynamically through tools/list.
Tests verify MCP protocol schemas are present in components.schemas.
bun run typecheck passes.
bun run lint --max-diagnostics=20 passes.
Focused OpenAPI/MCP projection tests for changed behavior pass.
bun run build passes.
userStories.notes: Keep JSON-RPC protocol schema separate from dynamic tool argument projections.

userStories.title: Add root MCP OpenAPI projection export
userStories.description: As an MCP consumer, I want a root-level projection of available MCP tool contracts so that I can translate tool schemas into OpenAPI-compatible components.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a root MCP tool or REST endpoint that exports root MCP tool contracts as an OpenAPI projection artifact.
Projection includes tool argument schemas derived from tools/list input schemas.
Projection includes stable tool names and descriptions.
Projection includes diagnostics for tools that cannot be mapped to OpenAPI-compatible schemas.
Projection returns profile, projection, refs, diagnostics, sources, versionHash, and typeTargets where available.
Projection validates with validateOpenApiProjection() or returns machine-readable validation diagnostics.
bun run typecheck passes.
bun run lint --max-diagnostics=20 passes.
Focused OpenAPI/MCP projection tests for changed behavior pass.
bun run build passes.
userStories.notes: This is the dynamic tool contract counterpart to the static MCP transport schemas.

userStories.title: Keep table-scoped projection integration
userStories.description: As an AI tool, I want static API discovery to link to table-scoped projection export so that I can retrieve current table schemas on demand.
acceptanceCriteria: Full document includes the table projection export endpoint.
Full document documents supported table projection profiles: component-bundle and operation-contract.
Full document documents invalid profile behavior.
Existing table-scoped MCP get-openapi-projection-{tableId} tool remains supported.
Existing table projection tests continue to pass.
Static full document does not become stale when table attributes change.
bun run typecheck passes.
bun run lint --max-diagnostics=20 passes.
Focused OpenAPI/MCP projection tests for changed behavior pass.
bun run build passes.
userStories.notes: This story protects dynamic table schema behavior from static document creep.
